title: Conversation
learning_outcomes: Explain open questions in the context of conversation.
Compare and distinguish turn-taking in the context of conversation.
Apply conversational repair in the context of conversation.
Evaluate and justify decisions about closing respectfully in the context of conversation.

lessons.title: Open questions
lessons.outcome: Explain open questions in the context of conversation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving open questions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to conversation role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain open questions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of open questions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Turn-taking
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish turn-taking in the context of conversation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving turn-taking; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to conversation role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain turn-taking from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of turn-taking; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Conversational repair
lessons.outcome: Apply conversational repair in the context of conversation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving conversational repair; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to conversation role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain conversational repair from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of conversational repair; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Closing respectfully
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about closing respectfully in the context of conversation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving closing respectfully; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to conversation role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain closing respectfully from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of closing respectfully; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of open questions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of turn-taking; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of conversational repair; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of closing respectfully; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
